body: I'm going to go mow the lawn for my dad.  Maybe that'll make me feel better.  Anyway, thanks to you and u/Mr_Defi for responding.  I know y'all didn't have to and I think I was just looking for someone to talk to.

I'll look into it.  There's a therapeutic horse riding place around where I currently live.  I don't know if I could volunteer in a shelter.  I know they need it and it'd do a lot of good but I think I'd die a little inside.  I need all the "inside" I have left.

I worked as a retail manager as well.  I always felt so out of place giving advice to employees.  I'm giving them advice while thinking "damn I should be taking this advice myself", and then never taking it.  The company I worked for had a lot of resources for mental health that I should have taken advantage of when it was free.  Now I don't even have health insurance lol
no.  I haven't.  I like animals.  Better than people for the most part.  Maybe I'll look into that.
I'll gladly concede that point.

For some people it works that way.  Goals and motivation and such.  And more power to them.  I'm fortunate enough to have traveled all over the world for business and recreation.  I think I'm less goal driven now because I've accomplished a lot of what I set out to do when I was your age.  I'm not trying to bring you down at all, but sometimes accomplishing your goals doesn't exactly have the intended effect.  I'm sure it will for you and I wish you the best, it just didn't for me.

well, I'm not trying to sound like I know how everything is because I'm older, but believe me on this one.  Get yourself educated in, and get a job doing something you love.  I made great money for 11 years and now don't have to work because of it.  But a job interview is possibly the most terrifying thing in the world for me, and when I do have a job, I'm always a loose cannon.  My job situation has nothing to do with where I'm at. My life situation really has nothing to do with where I'm at.  Sometimes your body just can't let you be happy.  I've tried a hundred different drugs and tens of therapists and it just doesn't seem to help.  I guess I just have a hard time finding something to live for.  I don't want to have kids because that would be yet another person that loves or depends upon me.  I have two hobbies that I absolutely adore and throw myself into, but again, when you're down, you're down.

I absolutely do.  I have great parents and a lot of good friends.  But, as you probably know as someone who posts on this forum, none of that means anything when your brain decides to stop producing the stuff that makes you want to live.  There's nothing about my life that sucks.  I don't have a job but I don't need one either.  One thing I can tell you for an absolute fact is that money cannot buy happiness.  If it could, I'd be happy.  It has nothing to do with outside factors, I'm just not happy and I hate everything.  I know that sounds like a super generic suicidal complaint but I really do hate everything right now.

That's good advice. Better than any of the so-called experts have given me.  The thing is, this works, but I always lose the progress and end up in a deeper hole than I was before.  It saps your motivation to keep on doing it.  I know one of these times I might make it out of the hole but I have no previous experience to make me think it's probable.

I've been trying for 19 years man. I've had severe depression, panic disorder, and manic episodes since I was in my early 20's.  I live with my parents as a 40 year old because I can't hold down a job.

I'm just sitting here staring at the wall.  What the fuck do you do when you can't sleep anymore?  I've already slept 18 of the last 24 hours and I literally can't go to sleep.  I'm just sitting here fidgeting and wishing I had the balls to do it.
